title: 6. Malicious earworms and useful memes: How the far-right surfs TikTok’s audio trends
reasoning: The paper evaluates TikTok's content moderation performance regarding hate speech, extremist ideologies, and protected groups (including mentions of Islamophobia). It specifically analyzes the ethical trade-offs between platform engagement and user well-being, as well as the moral implications of how hateful content is 'cloaked' or 'amplified' through the platform's infrastructure.
